purpose: Teach: 伊丹/長岡/武藤/菊池/亀田/五十嵐/塚本/八田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の伊丹部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our new department head, Itami.
lines.style: Measured authority. Clipped opening on the command verb. No inflection on the name—just fact. The tone of someone used to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の長岡課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the sales manager Nagaoka's travel schedule.
lines.style: Calm, efficient. Quick intake of the instruction. Even delivery that signals readiness to execute. No flourish—just competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の武藤主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the Muto team lead in technical operations to take the project.
lines.style: Same measured authority as before. Slightly heavier on the assignment itself. Expects compliance without question. The cadence of delegation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の菊池様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll adopt the strategy from PR director Kikuchi.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Slightly faster pace than before—he's moving through the checklist. Professional, no hesitation. One step ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の亀田様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Get the company advisor Kameda's counsel on this.
lines.style: Clipped command. Soft 't' on the verb—efficiency over ceremony. Same authority but briefer. He's in rhythm now.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の五十嵐様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll confirm the accounting manager Igarashi's closing schedule.
lines.style: Steady, unrushed. He's maintaining pace and composure through the sequence. Each confirmation sits lightly—already absorbing and organizing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の塚本様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Have HR manager Tsukamoto handle the new employee training program.
lines.style: Authoritative assignment. Slight pause before the name—precision matters here. The weight of responsibility in his voice. Still directive, still clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の八田様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request contract review from the legal department's Hatta.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly more deliberate—closing out the sequence. Clear, professional finality. The punctuation of a completed briefing.
